0022600162.text: The Orlando Magic (2-4, 0-3 at home, 10th in the East) host the Washington Wizards (3-3, 2-1 at home, 1st in the Southeast) in Orlando's seventh game of the season, with the Magic on a one-game losing streak. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Paolo Banchero, while Washington is missing Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie and Tristan Vukcevic, and Alex Sarr and Anthony Gill are day-to-day with game-time decisions. Orlando won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-131 win in Orlando on March 12, 2026, and the teams have not met yet this season.
